description: Creates a new version of a game and returns shell commands that zip the build folder (index.html at its root) and upload it straight to Gamealia with curl, using a 1-hour upload token for this version only. The commands run in a shell; complete_upload finishes the upload. No file bytes go through MCP. Clients without a shell can upload from the dashboard link in get_game instead. Web games only: mobile listings have no build.

buildDir.description: The build folder to zip (default: the current folder); it must contain index.html at its root

game.description: The game's slug or id (list_games shows them)

notes.description: Release notes: a short changelog of this version, in plain words for players. Required (at least 10 characters) to submit an update to a game that is already live

name: start_upload
title: Start a build upload
